description: Look up an existing appointment by phone number or booking reference to check status, date, time, and service details. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'lookup_booking_status' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: phone (optional), booking_id (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

booking_id.description: Unique booking identifier if known. Optional.

phone.description: Customer mobile number used during booking (e.g. "0821234567") [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

name: lookup_booking_status
title: Lookup Booking Status
